source.method: Independent photographic inspection plus white RGB>155/alpha>100 runs after ImageMagick resize2048x; thresholds only locate observed spans, not derived builder geometry.

contract: Cast along Z through registered XY. hit means frame geometry must occupy pixel, false means no frame geometry at pixel. Apply actual photograph registration, not the previous incorrecthead landmark. Samples are high-confidence exterior proportions, not CAD/100%certification; evaluate M/reference photo first before uncalibrated L interpolation.
